title: Support ticket result
description: The one record a support ticket run returns to Support. Teammates who can read the ticket read every text field here, so no field may quote an inbox report.

ticket_type.description: The one type the ticket was triaged into.

verdict.description: `actionable` when a report holds something an engineer can act on. `needs_input` when the customer must answer the clarifying questions before the ticket can move. `not_actionable` for everything else, including a question that the private note answers.

summary.description: One or two sentences that say what the customer asks for and what this run concluded.

unknowns.description: Facts the ticket does not give and that would change the answer.

clarifying_questions.description: Questions for the customer, in the order a teammate should ask them. Empty unless the verdict is `needs_input`.

private_note.description: Markdown for the team, posted on the ticket as a private note. It ends with a link to the report.

suggested_reply.description: A reply a teammate could send to the customer as it is. Omit it when no grounded reply exists.

knowledge_gap_topics.description: Topics the customer asked about that business knowledge search could not answer.
